description: Book a Full of Joy tour online for one tour, date and group. The team confirms the booking to the traveller by email with the final price and payment terms. Nothing is charged online. Only call this after the traveller agreed to share their name and email.

note.description: Optional message: pick-up place, interests, children, etc.
